summary_en: This phase 1 study tests autologous CAR-T cells that target B7-H3 (iC9.CAR.B7-H3 T cells) in people with refractory pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The cells are made from each participant's own blood and given by intravenous infusion over 5 to 10 minutes, and how often they are given is not stated. The study measures safety and tolerability, as stated in its purpose, and it is a phase 1 study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba células CAR-T autólogas dirigidas contra B7-H3 (células iC9.CAR.B7-H3) en personas con adenocarcinoma ductal de páncreas refractario. Las células se fabrican a partir de la sangre de cada participante y se administran por vía intravenosa en 5 a 10 minutos; la frecuencia con la que se administran no se indica. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, según se indica en su objetivo, y es un estudio de fase 1.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who give written informed consent.
Histological or cytological confirmation of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
Women who could become pregnant must abstain or use two effective contraception methods until 6 months after treatment stops.
Men with female partners must have had a vasectomy or use an adequate contraception method during and for 3 months after cell infusion.
not_for: Prior or current other cancer whose course or treatment could interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.
Not willing or able to follow study procedures, based on investigator judgment.
